reason: I've never heard of Nora Furnish, and I'd rather pay a bit more at Wayfair, Lowe's or Amazon where returns and delivery are known. A 10 to 12 day wait and paying return shipping on a big fixture if it looks wrong in my room is a risk I don't need.
objection: If a $360 fixture shows up and I don't like it, I eat the return shipping on a big box, and I have no idea whether this store will even answer me.
would_change_my_mind: Free returns (prepaid label) on fixtures, plus proof the store is established, like reviews I can check elsewhere, or seeing the same lights on Amazon or Wayfair.
